entries.text: See, I was thinking I could hold my hand like...\nthis. Get me? Then I swing my leg, and...hyah![VAR 0x0114(004F)]

entries.text:

Talking through this with you really helped!
We’ve come up with a real home run here!\c
If you ever want to change how you throw your
Poké Balls, just give me another call![VAR 0x0114(004F)]
